auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your Geem account. Workspace membership does not grant Platform Admin access.
auth.logoutConfirmHint: You will need to sign in again to use Geem Admin.
auth.logoutAllConfirmHint: This ends every active session for your account.
auth.accessRequiredBody: This account is signed in but is not a Platform Admin. Workspace Owner or Administrator roles do not grant access here.
auth.brandHeadline: Operate Geem from a dedicated admin surface.
auth.brandBody: Manage the platform independently of any Workspace. Tenant membership never becomes Platform Admin access.
auth.highlightHostBody: Geem Admin lives on its own host. It is not a tenant application.
auth.highlightRoleBody: Access requires a Platform Admin account. Workspace roles cannot grant this.
auth.highlightAuditBody: High-impact mutations in later phases write to the existing audit log.

overview.title: Overview
overview.context: You are in Platform Admin. This surface is independent of Workspace membership and tenant RBAC.

placeholder.title: {{section}}
placeholder.body: This section is reserved for a later Phase 12 slice. No management APIs are available here yet.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before signing in.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this resource.
errors.validation: Check the form and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.platformAdminHostRequired: This API is only available on the Platform Admin host.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Global inventory of Geem Workspaces. Default list shows tenant Workspaces.
workspaces.disableHint: Disabling prevents its users, API keys, and connected channels from using Geem until the Workspace is enabled again.
workspaces.enableHint: Re-enabling restores normal access. It does not reset subscriptions, credits, or data.
workspaces.systemProtected: System Workspaces are protected and cannot be disabled here.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Global inventory of Geem accounts.
users.disableHint: Disabling revokes active sessions and blocks sign-in until the account is enabled again.
users.enableHint: Re-enabling allows the user to sign in again. Existing Workspace memberships are unchanged.
users.selfProtected: You cannot disable your own Platform Admin account from this screen.
